title: Sake Brewery
paragraphs: “Ahh, welcome back, heroes.”
Big sister, her older sister, and her friend, who seemed a bit excited, were waiting while looking drowsy. Keel and the others must already be asleep.
“Look, Raphtalia-chan, Rifana-chan. The heroes are back, so it’s time for bed.”
“Okay.”
“Welcome back, Naofumi-sama. How did it go?”
“Thanks to Motoyasu-kun’s efforts, we were able to capture all the villains in Faubrey.”
I puffed my chest with pride at Father’s explanation. Referring to them as villains was just to make it easier for the children to understand.
“I want to hear all about it.”
“Hmm… maybe when you’re a little older, Rifana-chan. In the meantime, I’ll tell you some fairy tales I know.”
Father looked troubled for a moment but quickly diverted big sister’s friend by changing the subject.
“I was wondering if he’d tell the little ones, but of course, he didn’t.”
“There’s no way he could.”
“Honestly, it was the right decision not to bring them along.”
“Does Sakura-chan know?”
Big sister’s friend tilted her head and asked Sakura-chan.
“Um, well… there was this huge pig—”
“Sakura-chan, please don’t go into detail.”
“Hmm? Okay.”
Sakura-chan smiled gently at big sister’s friend to calm her down. And then…
“Well, um… there was this guy who cheated and hoarded the seven star weapons all for himself. When Motoyasu pointed it out, he went berserk. Then, after we took him down, a dragon appeared—”
Sakura-chan explained everything to big sister’s friend. Big sister’s friend kept nodding eagerly. With that kind of explanation, it’s nonfiction, but it can be enjoyed like an adventure tale.
“We’ll have to tell Keel-kun and the others later too.”
“Yeah…”
“Come on now, Raphtalia-chan, Rifana-chan. It’s time for bed.”

Big sister’s older sister gently urged them to go to sleep. Father seemed to agree. They took big sister and the others to the bedroom to tuck them in. We also got ready for bed. But before that, big sister’s older sister brought some sake from the mansion’s cellar.
“Well then, heroes, why don’t you have a drink with me?”
“Ren and Itsuki are underage.”
Since I had already warned them that big sister’s older sister was a heavy drinker and only someone on Father’s level could handle her, Ren and Itsuki obediently chose to go to bed.
“Ah, yeah. I’ll head to bed first. Kuro, stop being so excited and get some rest.”
“You’re right. Tomorrow’s going to be busy. We should rest early. Kou, you should go to sleep too. And stop messing with my hair.”
“Okay!”
With that, Kuro and Kou left the mansion and sat in their filolial forms in the garden, nodding off.
“Yuki-chan, you should go to bed soon too. Staying up late is bad for your beauty and health. You wouldn’t want your feathers to get dirty.”
“Understood. This Yuki values beauty, so I’ll go to bed early.”
Saying that, Yuki-chan gracefully trotted off to the room assigned to me.
“Ahh, just a little bit is fine, isn’t it?”
“Father will keep big sister’s older sister company.”
“Well… I guess that’s fine. But don’t stay up too late, okay? Sakura-chan, just in case, take care of Raphtalia-chan.”
“Got it!”
Following Father’s instructions, Sakura-chan went to the bedroom where big sister was sleeping. She will surely protect her no matter what happens.
“Oh?”
“Raphtalia-chan… when she sleeps deeply, she tends to scream from nightmares. So, someone needs to watch over her.”
“Really? Then I’ll take care of her later.”
“Could I ask you to do that? Up until now, Sakura-chan, Rifana-chan, and I have been taking care of her every night. It would be great if Sadina-san could help too.”
Father glanced toward the bedroom.
“…The other kids probably have similar traumas. I shouldn’t drink too much.”
“Oh my.”

Saying that, big sister’s older sister handed Father a cup filled with sake. Of course, I was given some as well. I took a sip, but as expected, it was very strong. It’s not something you can drink several cups of.
“I’ll go look for some special sake.”

Father couldn’t afford to drink for too long with big sister’s older sister. In that case, it was best to quickly bring something that would satisfy her. Yes, that’s it. So, I went to the mansion’s cellar and brought back that fruit.
“I can’t thank you enough for protecting Raphtalia-chan, Rifana-chan, and Keel-chan.”
“Ah… yeah… they’re all such good kids. There’s no reason they should have been made slaves.”
“By the way, Shield Hero… is it okay if I call you Naofumi-chan? What do you intend to do with those kids?”

“Even if you ask that… my only wish is what I said earlier today. From what I’ve heard, there are dangerous elements in this country, but Raphtalia-chan wants to restore the village. Those dangerous elements are also my enemies… and since they helped me, I just want to help them in return.”

Father responded to big sister’s older sister while staring at the cup of sake in his hand. Big sister’s older sister quietly stared at Father. It didn’t seem like my imagination that she looked slightly amused. Her expression even seemed to hold a hint of ridicule. However, her expression changed with what Father said next.
“…No, maybe it’s just my selfishness. I just hate seeing pitiful children suffering in front of me… Even today, I defeated the enemy without knowing their circumstances…”
But then, Father continued, addressing big sister’s older sister.

“Sometimes I remember… Raphtalia-chan screaming as she was whipped, and Rifana-chan, who was so weak she was on the verge of death… I realized just how cruel people can be… That’s why I want these kind-hearted children to be happy.”
Father’s gaze grew distant.
“I understand how Sadina-san feels. Thinking it would be safer for them to leave this country… But Raphtalia-chan wants to rebuild her village, and Keel-kun and the other slaves feel the same.”
“…Yes, Raphtalia-chan and the others are quite stubborn about it.”

“I think… it’s because they were truly happy in that village. The land governed by the lord who was said to have died in the wave… Even in Melromarc, where demi-humans are supposed to be discriminated against, that place was so good that even the children remember it fondly. If they want to work hard to rebuild it, I want to help them as much as I can.”
Father replied to big sister’s older sister with a slightly self-deprecating tone.

“…Before I was summoned, I lived in a peaceful country. I liked having fun. But when I saw Raphtalia-chan with that strained look, worrying about everyone… I just want to make sure she never shows such a pained smile again. Is it wrong… to pursue that selfish wish?”
“…No. If Naofumi-chan wants that, I’m sure Raphtalia-chan, Rifana-chan, Keel-chan, and all the other kids will be happy.”
At that, big sister’s older sister gulped down her sake.
“Things are getting a bit too gloomy. Let’s drink more cheerfully, shall we? So, Naofumi-chan, how about a drinking contest with me?”
“I’m not really a fan of drinking too much though…”
That’s when I took the opportunity to bring in the Lukor fruit and a barrel of water.
“I figured you’d say that, so I brought this. Big sister’s older sister, this is for you.”
I placed the water barrel in front of big sister’s older sister, removed the lid, and dropped in one Lukor fruit. And the bunch of Lukor fruit was placed in front of Father.
“Here you go, Father. Please enjoy.”
“Huh? Oh, thanks.”
“Eh?”
Big sister’s older sister, who had been stirring the barrel, stared in shock as Father took a fruit from the bunch and started eating it.
“Wow… this is so fruity and rich in flavor. I could get addicted to these.”
Father began munching on the Lukor fruit enthusiastically.
“Ugh…”
Big sister’s older sister pressed her hand to her mouth.
“Naofumi-chan, are you okay?”
“Why wouldn’t I be?”
Father tilted his head.
“I forgot to explain. No matter how much Father drinks, he doesn’t get drunk.”
“Ah, you did mention that.”
“Oh my…”

Saying that, big sister’s older sister lightly picked up a Lukor fruit from the bunch that Father was eating and gave it a lick. If she does something like that, even big sister’s older sister might get drunk.
“Ugh… Naofumi-chan, you’re amazing.”
Big sister’s older sister’s gaze seemed a little hazy and warmer than before. It was starting to resemble the look she had last time.
“Let’s have some fun together, okay?”
“Uh, I think it’s about time… we called it a night.”
As Father stood up, a scream echoed from the bedroom, but it quickly quieted down. Sakura-chan must be sleeping beside her.
“Did Raphtalia-chan have a nightmare…?”
“By the way, I heard that big sister had a bed-wetting incident recently.”
“Let’s keep that a secret, okay?”

While staying in the Dracia Mountains, big sister apparently wet the bed. I remember Father looking troubled as he helped her wash the sheets at the well. When I noticed, he asked me to keep it a secret from everyone.
“There might be other kids besides Raphtalia-chan struggling with nightmares. Just in case, I’ll do a quick patrol before going to bed. Motoyasu, you should get some rest.”
“Then maybe I’ll help out too. Umm… are there any kids still shaken up…?”

With that, big sister’s older sister and Father continued discussing things. After cleaning up the cups and barrel they had used, I followed Father’s instructions and returned to my room to sleep. Yuki-chan snuggled up beside me, so I gently stroked her. I had a wonderful dream about going on a fun date with Filo-tan.
